hero_signature: Full-bleed grayscale wedding photo at brightness-50 with top-to-bottom noir gradient. 6s alternating slow-zoom (scale 1.0 -> 1.05) keyframe on the image. Centered Cormorant Garamond italic semibold headline at 5xl-8xl. Below: brass-gold italic Cormorant CTA pill with cream hover state.

section_flow.notes: Fixed nav. Cormorant italic wordmark left. Manrope link list center with underline-grow after:pseudo-elements. Italic Cormorant 'Inquire' link in brass on the right. Shrinks + adds bg/blur after 50px scroll.

Outer wrapper is (slideCount * 100)vh tall. Inner is sticky h-screen with a horizontal Framer Motion flex track driven by useScroll progress: x = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0,1], ['0%', '-(n-1)*100%']). 6 slides: intro card (couple/venue/quote + portrait), 4 photo cards (75vh grayscale brightness-75), outro italic quote.
CSS columns masonry (1/2/3 col at sm/md/lg). Each tile is grayscale brightness-75 with an opacity-0 hover overlay revealing italic brass couple name + uppercase tracked venue/date.
Grayscale 3:4 portrait left. Brass kicker + italic Cormorant headline + italic blockquote + supporting paragraph right.

3 columns. Center 'Most Popular' card has solid brass border + brass-tinted bg + brass-glow shadow + brass header badge. Side cards border-cream with brass-color italic title. Each shows price (4xl bold tracking-tight) + duration + ✦-bulleted features + brass-gold reserve-this-date CTA.
4 columns. Vertical brass hairline behind. Each column: italic brass 5xl numeral + medium 18px title + small body.
3 stacked quotes. Each: italic Cormorant 2xl brass quote + uppercase tracked-widest small attribution.

Form layout: Partner One / Partner Two row, Email / Wedding Date row, Venue full-width, Story textarea, How-did-you-find-us select. All inputs are transparent with cream/30 bottom borders that turn brass on focus.
Italic Cormorant studio name + cream/50 tagline + brass email link. Right: 3x2 instagram preview grid (grayscale aspect-square) with a 'View Instagram' tile.

notable_features: Sticky-horizontal-scroll story section driven by Framer Motion useScroll + useTransform
Brass-gold italic Cormorant button pattern (cream hover, brass-glow shadow on lift)
Underline-grow link hovers via after:pseudo width transition
Most-Popular package tier with solid brass border + brass-tinted bg + brass-glow shadow
Italic Cormorant pull-quote testimonials as standalone scroll moments
Transparent form inputs with cream/30 bottom borders (focus -> brass)
Grayscale brightness-75 on all photography (cinematic mood)
Top-to-bottom noir gradient overlay on hero (anchor-the-headline)
motion_vocabulary: Reveal: opacity 0->1 + y 24->0 over 1s with [0.22,1,0.36,1] easing on viewport-enter, once-only
Hero CTA delayed-fade: 0.8s opacity entrance with 0.8s delay after headline
Slow-zoom: keyframe scale 1.0 -> 1.05 over 6s, infinite alternate, cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)
Brass button hover: translateY(-2px) + brass drop-shadow
Masonry overlay: opacity 0 -> 1 + brightness 0.75 -> 1 + grayscale 1 -> 0 over 700ms
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce -> all transitions clamped to 0.01ms; slow-zoom keyframe disabled
tailwind_extras_inline_css: .btn-brass (brass bg, noir text, italic Cormorant, hover cream + translateY + brass glow). .form-input-ed (transparent + cream/30 bottom border, brass on focus). .hero-zoom (slow-zoom keyframe). .masonry-ed + .masonry-item-ed (CSS columns 1/2/3 with break-inside avoid). Tokens: --color-noir, --color-cream, --color-brass, --color-sepia, --font-display (Cormorant Garamond), --font-sans (Manrope).
